Name: Alx's Additions
Author: callmealx
Description:
New crops (including multiple winter crops), a new fruit tree, 4 new fish (including one new Legendary!), new recipes, and 12 new forageables!
Plus gift tastes for every item and unique responses!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/6q2P6Cr.png[/img]

Feel free to translate, the i18n files are all in there!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/iwSC4yc.png[/img]

Should be compatible with most other mods including Love of Cooking!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Bm80TzH.png[/img]


Known bugs:
-The recipe for the Fruit Smoothie needs ANY FRUIT - the icon is bugged and I'm not sure why.
-Purchasable recipes show up as a torch... for some reason? When purchased they'll be normal.
-Fish Ponds are still just requiring one bait for each expansion, again, I'm not really sure why. (Any help would be great!)

Coming VERY soon:
More gift tastes and response, and machine exports.

Coming in the near future:
At least one new NPC and more fruit trees.

Coming after that: 
Alx's Additions 2.0! A new location, complete with friendable NPCs, homes for them all, a market with stalls, lots of crops, recipes, forageables, machines, and more trees! Coming... eventually.
